## The problem

What goes wrong or costs too much today? A real example helps most.

## The proposal

## Does it keep the core rules?

- Default stays "do it yourself"; delegation only when it pays.
- No always-running agents, no self-spawning swarms, no commits or deletions without the user's approval.
- Works in both Claude Code and Codex, or says clearly where it doesn't.
